title: Clap and Stomp
output: Print n lines. Line i contains what is said for the number i.

samples.output:
1
2
Clap
4
Stomp
Clap
7
8
Clap
Stomp
11
Clap
13
14
ClapStomp

hints: Use a loop from 1 to n and the remainder operator `%`.
Check "divisible by both 3 and 5" (that is, by 15) first, before the single checks.
editorial:
Loop i from 1 to n. If `i % 15 == 0` print `ClapStomp`, else if `i % 3 == 0` print `Clap`, else if `i % 5 == 0` print `Stomp`, else print i. The order of the checks matters: 15 is divisible by 3 too, so the combined case must come first.

Complexity: O(n).
